name: mondeviscopro.fr
positioning: Vos appels d'offres copropriétés en 5 minutes, gratuitement.
description: mondeviscopro.fr is a free French marketplace that lets condominium managers request competing quotes from a network of vetted contractors for regulatory diagnostics, energy-renovation work and related studies. It was launched by AMOA SAS, previously an energy-renovation project-management-assistance (AMO) firm for condominiums.
real_estate_use: A condominium manager facing a mandatory energy diagnostic or renovation vote fills a short form describing the building and the service needed, and the platform automatically solicits up to three vetted contractors on their behalf. Quotes arrive by email and are compared on one screen instead of the manager chasing each contractor individually. Once the general assembly has voted, the platform follows up automatically to record the decision and let the selected contractor start.
features: Automatic matching with up to three vetted contractors
Coverage of DPE, PPPT, DTG, asbestos and lead diagnostics, and energy-renovation works

use_cases.job: Launch a call for tenders for a regulatory diagnostic or energy-renovation work without contacting contractors one by one
